official: 府中市後期高齢者医療に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会市長提出議案
令和8年第1回定例会議決結果

name: 公示送達の方法を変更
summary: 現在、公示送達は市の掲示場に掲示して行っています。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を設けたうえで、掲示場への書面掲示か、市の事務所に設置した電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる方法で行う形に変えます。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にし、掲示場への書面掲示か市の事務所の画面で閲覧できる状態にする
who: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達を受ける人
why: 高齢者の医療の確保に関する法律で準用する地方税法の一部改正に伴う改正のためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how service by public notice is carried out
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Fuchu City Ordinance on Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Currently, service by public notice is carried out by posting notices on the city’s bulletin board. Under this bill, measures will be put in place to make the matters being announced viewable by an unspecified number of people. Service will then be carried out either by posting a written notice on the bulletin board or by making it viewable on a computer screen installed at a city office.
changes: Make the matters being announced viewable by an unspecified number of people, then post a written notice on the bulletin board or make the notice viewable on a screen at a city office
who: People receiving service by public notice concerning medical care for older senior citizens
en.why: The city says the ordinance is being amended in response to a partial amendment of the Local Tax Act, which is applied under the Act on Assurance of Medical Care for Elderly People.
